brief:
The Committee of Families of Political Detainees has urged Palestinians to report cases of arbitrary arrest and summonses by authorities in the West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. The committee is seeking documentation of violations as part of efforts to expose detention practices and hold security forces accountable for their conduct.

The appeal comes amid ongoing concerns over arrest and interrogation procedures in Palestinian territories. The committee has positioned itself as a mechanism for gathering testimonies and evidence of alleged abuses, with a focus on cases involving political detainees. Officials said the reporting initiative aims to create a comprehensive record of violations that can be used to press authorities on detention standards and legal protections.
